status: Diagnostic only;3e remains unaccepted. No reserve policy changed.
limitations: Station bins are50m and sample residence time at1/120s; they do not follow identical trajectories across sources.

The final-finisher lap event is not appended because the exact original loop exits after PHASE.FINISHED; final best/classification values and native control bins are still retained. No sector value is invented for that omitted event.
This collector does not hook fall(); incident lap/station attribution from its residence bins and yellow response remains inference until a bounded onset capture.

Current force is queried at actual committed bar/current contacts/prior Fx. Allocation trials freeze existing controller demand/target/trim/bar and do not prove future arrest or final-force fixed-point adequacy.
Allocation replays cover a10Hz subset of historical-winning states. Nonwinning10Hz samples separately retain current-would-win counts and strongest states.
Positive net longitudinal-force delta is not a time-gain estimate; it may mean more drive or less braking. Negative delta may mean more braking or less drive.
JSON represents nonfinite diagnostic aggregates as null; these are not used as finite means. All native acceptance/replay comparisons occurred before serialization.
